g_policy.reason: The offer copy 'Play a short game for a welcome-back surprise!' doesn't state the reward (what and how much) before the ad, so the copy fails the policy condition. The card is opt-in, and the decline and failure paths are fine.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning answers that expire at midnight. That is not cash or anything that works like cash.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days without a session, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal says it removes nothing free. The only gated resource is Advanced reasoning mode, which the paywall (s02.e03) lists as a paid feature.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card is app chrome on the Chats home screen (s01), which is rated safe. It is not in the message list or over a chat.

c1_revealed_value.reason: Advanced reasoning mode is a paywall bullet (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The claim that Advanced reasoning mode is paid rests on s02.e03 and l02. The card, the reward and the copy are the proposal's own additions, and the reward is labelled as an inference. The cost and market remarks are predictions.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The 'subscribers' field says Luzia+ members never see the offer. The reward is also something their plan includes, so they are spared.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is 3 answers that end at midnight or when used up. It is a sample that expires, and it takes nothing from other users.

c5_moment.reason: The card is dismissible and shown on the home screen at app open, before the user starts any task, so it interrupts nothing.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The reward arrives after a confirmed play, and an unconfirmed play gives a retry note instead. The trigger, an open after a 3+ day gap, is an app event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Luzia+ paywall feature 'Advanced reasoning mode', the Chats home screen, the Luzia+ badge and the 'How can I help you today?' prompt card, so it would not read the same in another app.

other_concern: The proposal's reward line is marked 'inference', and it is unclear how the app will tell that the day's 3 answers come from reasoning mode. The copy also needs to name the reward, for example 'Play a short game to unlock 3 Advanced reasoning answers today'.
